tasks.short: Direct searchers and keep evaluating titles.

steps.what: List records the workers still search.
Direct activities of workers who examine titles.
Keep providing technical guidance where necessary.
Note the titles they are evaluating.

tasks.design: The examiner directs the workers, keeps assigning and scheduling the searches, keeps providing technical guidance, and notes the titles they are evaluating. {DOCS} only lists records the workers still search. There is no score and no output dashboard. The workers are not recorded. The list does not assign the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The open searches were collected by asking each worker before the examiner could direct them.
tasks.enabler_now: A queue can list searches that are still open.
tasks.still_hard: Who searches which title, and whether the work is sound, stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner directs and evaluates. A list does not.
tasks.altitude: Directing, assigning, scheduling, providing guidance, and evaluating stay in full. Only the list of open searches is shorter.

reach.task: Take the search the examiner assigns
reach.learn: The examiner still directs and evaluates

evidence.claim: This design does not score examiners and does not record calls.
A parcel query can list instruments the register already indexes. It does not examine them.

assumptions: The workflow starts when searches are open and ends when the examiner has directed, assigned, and evaluated. Nothing is sent. There is no score field.
The fields are the worker and the open search. The queue produces the open list. The examiner directs. There is no score field.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the directing and the evaluating stay. The open list is the part that moves.
unknowns: Whether the queue already names the worker on each open search.
Which guidance the office treats as necessary on every search.
research_questions: Does the queue already name the worker on each open search?
Which guidance does the office treat as necessary on every search?

tasks.short: Summarize legal details from reference books.

steps.what: Open the reference books they named.
Select sections of statutes for the proofs.
Summarize pertinent legal and insurance details.
Accept the examinations as a ready reference.

tasks.design: The examiner selects the sections, summarizes the pertinent legal and insurance details, and accepts the examinations as a ready reference. {DOCS} only opens the reference books they named, then files the summary they accepted. The examiner writes every line and the page. A line with no page they named is not accepted and is not filed. Nothing adds a citation.
tasks.previous_blocker: A book they had already named took time to find on the shelf.
tasks.enabler_now: A book the office already holds can be opened by the name they wrote.
tasks.still_hard: Which section is pertinent, and which page supports the line, stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner writes the summary. An opened book does not.
tasks.altitude: Selecting the sections, summarizing the details, and accepting the reference stay in full. Only opening the named book and filing the accepted summary are shorter.

reach.task: Use the summary the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not add a citation

evidence.claim: A summary used in an examination must not add a citation the examiner did not take from the book in front of them. A line with no page is not filed.
Confidential title files are not pasted into a free tool. A copy uses only fields the examiner already marked.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the examiner has named a reference book and ends when the accepted summary is filed. The examiner writes every line. A line with no page is not filed. Nothing adds a citation.
The fields are book name, section, and page. The examiner produces every line and the page. A line with no page is not filed. Nothing adds a citation.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the summary stays. The open and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the reference books they use are already held as page images.
Which examinations require a page citation before a line may be filed.
research_questions: Are the reference books they use already held as page images?
Which examinations require a page citation before a line may be filed?

tasks.short: Prepare closing statements and file them.

steps.what: Prepare amounts for the estate closing statements.
Review statements using their knowledge, expertise, and procedures.

tasks.design: The examiner reviews the statements using their knowledge, expertise, and procedures, and accepts them. {SPREADSHEET} only adds the stated amounts. {DOCS} files the statements they accepted. The calculation does not replace a wrong input. They do not accept a statement the figures do not support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stated amounts were added by hand on the closing statement.
tasks.enabler_now: Stated amounts can be added in the sheet the office already uses.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the statement is right under their procedures stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner accepts the statement. Arithmetic does not.
tasks.altitude: The review and the acceptance stay in full. Only adding the stated amounts and filing the accepted statements are shorter.

reach.task: Use the closing statement the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The closer does not accept the figures

evidence.claim: A closing figure is arithmetic on stated amounts. A wrong input is not replaced.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when stated amounts are on the closing file and ends when the accepted statement is filed. The examiner reviews and accepts. A figure that does not add is not filed.
The fields are the amount name and the amount. The file produces the stated amounts. The examiner produces the acceptance. A figure that does not add is not filed.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the review stays. The addition and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether every amount on the statement is already stated on the file.
Which procedures require a figure the sheet cannot compute.
research_questions: Is every amount on the statement already stated on the file?
Which procedures require a figure the sheet cannot compute?

tasks.short: Determine whether documents can be registered.

steps.what: Read related documents presented for registration.
Determine whether the documents can be registered.
Determine the relevant titles legislation that applies.
Accept whether the documents can be registered.
File the decision on whether documents can be registered.

tasks.design: The examiner determines whether the documents can be registered and which relevant titles legislation applies, then accepts that decision. {DOCS} only opens the related documents and files the decision they accepted. Filing is not registration. The registrar registers, if anyone does. National rules differ on who may register.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same document was opened by hunting the folder before the examiner could read it.
tasks.enabler_now: A document already presented can be opened by its id.
tasks.still_hard: Whether it can be registered, and under which legislation, stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner determines. A filed note does not register the document.
tasks.altitude: The determination and the acceptance stay in full. Only opening the document and filing the accepted decision are shorter.

reach.task: Read the decision the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The registrar, not this file, registers the document

evidence.claim: National rules differ on who may register a document and on which legislation applies. The examiner determines whether it can be registered. This file does not register it.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a related document is presented and ends when the accepted decision is filed. The examiner determines. The file is not the act of registration.
The fields are document id, the legislation they name, and can-register yes or no. The examiner produces the decision. The file is not the act of registration.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the determination stays. The open and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether the registrar accepts a filed decision from the examiner as the start of registration.
Which legislation the office expects the examiner to name on each document type.
research_questions: Does the registrar accept a filed decision from the examiner as the start of registration?
Which legislation does the office expect the examiner to name on each document type?
